records.name: RenderPropertyOptions
records.raw:
"""
Render > Render Properties (engine, finish conditions, quality, color mapping) for UtilityAPI::SetRenderingProperties, without the dialog.
"""
m_RenderEngineType:int          # render engine: 0 = CPU, 1 = GPU (CUDA / HIP, or Metal on Apple silicon) (default 0)
m_bCPUSupporting:bool           # if true, the CPU renders along with the GPU; GPU engine only (default false)
m_bLowGPUPriority:bool          # if true, leave GPU time to other programs; GPU engine only (default false)
m_NoiseThreshold:float          # noise level at which rendering stops, 0.001-0.1; lower is cleaner but slower (default 0.01)
m_MaxRenderTime:int             # maximum render time in minutes, 1-100 (default 0 = keep the current value)
m_SeamPuckeringIntensity:float  # strength of seam puckering in the render, 0-5 (default 0.5)
m_LightQuality:int              # light quality: 0 = low, 1 = medium, 2 = high, 3 = very high (default 0)
m_MaterialQuality:int           # material quality: 0 = low, 1 = medium, 2 = high, 3 = very high (default 0)
m_bKnitWearFrustumCulling:bool  # if true, skip knitwear mesh outside the camera view; final render only (default true)
m_bKnitWearLOD:bool             # if true, use knitwear level of detail (mesh optimization); final render only (default true)
m_ColorMappingType:int          # color mapping: 0 = HSV exponential, 1 = Reinhard (uses m_BurnValue) (default 0)
m_BurnValue:float               # Reinhard burn value, 0-1 (1 = linear); used when m_ColorMappingType is 1 (default 0.5)
m_bLinearWorkFlow:bool          # if true, render with the linear workflow (default false)
m_ImageFilterSize:float         # image filter size, 1-10 (default 1)

records.name: SeamlinePairGroupResult
records.raw:
"""
Status code returned by the AddSeamlinePairGroupPartial family of APIs.
SEAMLINE_PAIR_SUCCESS is 0 and every failure is negative, so test the result with
'== SEAMLINE_PAIR_SUCCESS' rather than for truthiness (0 is falsy in Python).
"""
SEAMLINE_PAIR_SUCCESS = 0                     # The stitch was created.
SEAMLINE_PAIR_ERROR_NO_PATTERN_EDITOR = -1    # No pattern editor is available in the current scene.
SEAMLINE_PAIR_ERROR_INVALID_PATTERN = -2      # A pattern index does not refer to an existing pattern.
SEAMLINE_PAIR_ERROR_INVALID_INNER_SHAPE = -3  # An inner shape (child) index does not refer to an existing inner shape.
SEAMLINE_PAIR_ERROR_INVALID_LINE = -4         # A line index does not refer to an existing line on the given shape.
SEAMLINE_PAIR_ERROR_RATIO_OUT_OF_RANGE = -5   # A start/end ratio lies outside the closed range [0.0, 1.0].
SEAMLINE_PAIR_ERROR_EMPTY_SEGMENT = -6        # A start ratio is not strictly less than its end ratio, so the segment is empty or inverted.
SEAMLINE_PAIR_ERROR_CREATE_FAILED = -7        # The stitch passed validation but the pattern editor rejected it.

"""
Options for AOP (All Over Print) texture transformation operations
Provides parameters to control texture transformations including rotation, scaling, and translation.
Supports both percentage-based and millimeter-based sizing.
"""

widthMm:float          # Width in millimeters (system unit). Set to 0.0 to use widthPercent instead.

heightMm:float         # Height in millimeters (system unit). Set to 0.0 to use heightPercent instead.
heightPercent:float    # Height as percentage (100.0 = 100%, original size)
aspectRatioFixed:bool  # true to maintain aspect ratio during scaling, false to allow independent width/height scaling
posX:float             # Horizontal position/translation in display units
posY:float             # Vertical position/translation in display units}

records.raw:
"""
Settings of one wind controller (Object Browser > Scene > Wind) for UtilityAPI::SetWindControllerSettings / GetWindControllerSettings. Set writes every field.
"""
bWindActive:bool  # true = the wind controller is on (default false)
windType:int      # 0 = spherical (blows outward from the controller), any other value = planar (along its direction) (default 0)
strength:float    # wind strength, as Strength in the Property Editor (default 0)
decay:float       # how fast the strength fades with distance, 0-100 (default 0)
frequency:float   # gust period in seconds, 0-100000; 0 = constant wind (default 0)
turbulence:float  # random variation of the strength, 0-100 (default 0)
x:float           # X position of the controller in 3D, in mm (default 0)
y:float           # Y position of the controller in 3D, in mm (default 0)
z:float           # Z position of the controller in 3D, in mm (default 0)
rotationX:float   # rotation around the X axis in degrees; the wind blows along the rotated +Z axis (default 0)
rotationY:float   # rotation around the Y axis in degrees (default 0)
rotationZ:float   # rotation around the Z axis in degrees (default 0)

"""
Specifies the zipper part type to generate via GenerateZippersFromObj.
Each value corresponds to a specific output file format and save behavior.
"""
ZIPPER_OBJECT_SLIDER = 0                 # Slider only (.zsl): single OBJ input, saved as a single shape.
ZIPPER_OBJECT_PULLER = 1                 # Puller only (.zpu): single OBJ input, saved as a single shape.
ZIPPER_OBJECT_SLIDER_PULLER = 2          # Slider + Puller combined (.zss): single OBJ with two meshes, saved as dual shape.
ZIPPER_OBJECT_TEETH = 3                  # Zipper teeth (.zth): single OBJ, loaded with fixed internal axes.
ZIPPER_OBJECT_TOP_STOPPER = 4            # Top stopper (.zst): two OBJ inputs, saved as dual shape.
ZIPPER_OBJECT_BOTTOM_OPEN_STOPPER = 5    # Bottom open-end stopper (.zst): two OBJ inputs, saved as dual shape.
ZIPPER_OBJECT_BOTTOM_CLOSED_STOPPER = 6  # Bottom closed-end stopper (.zst): single OBJ input, saved as a single shape.
